# Deputy Registrar, Vehicle Section

Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure Development

Harare, Zimbabwe

Open only to current government employees — verified by EC Number.

## Role Overview

Participate in the formulation, implementation and review of vehicle licenses application and issuance policies, regulations and procedures in line with the Ministry's mandate, strategic plan as well as national development imperatives; Develop strategic plans to guide the operations of the Vehicle Licenses Section at the Central Vehicle Registry; Monitor the processing of applications for Vehicle Licenses in line with the Section's standard operating procedures; Develop synergies with stakeholders and partners like Law enforcement agencies, ZINARA and other Local Authorities on the issuance and Management of Vehicles licenses; Prepare and submit statements for use by by the Law enforcement agencies in respect of Vehicle licences requirements and status thereof; Appear in Court of Law as a state witness on behalf of the Registrar on Vehicle Licenses litigation

  * Sound negotiating skills

Below are other issues noted during the audit:

**1. GOVERNANCE ISSUES**

**1.1 Standard Operating Procedures Manual**

**Finding**

There was no standard operating procedures manual for the Fund giving guidance on the accounting and administration activities of the fund. The field visits to six provinces namely Mashonaland East, West and Central, Midlands, Bulawayo and Matabeleland South, in November 2024 revealed that there was no uniform approach in the day to day running of the Fund. This was contrary to the provisions of section 50 of the Public Finance Management Act [Chapter 22:19] which states that every public entity shall adhere to and implement the principles of sound corporate governance policies, procedures and practices.

**Risk/Implication**

Without Standard Operating Procedures Manual, staff may perform tasks differently, leading to errors, varied outcomes and poor quality of work.

**Recommendation**

The Fund should develop a standard operating procedures manual to standardize operations.
